cases.query: How long do I have to return an unused physical product?
cases.answer: Most approved refunds are submitted to the payment provider within 2 business days, and banks may take an additional 3 to 7 business days to post the credit. Customers can request a refund within 30 calendar days of delivery for unused physical products in resalable condition. Refund status can be checked after a return is received. Refunds are returned to the original payment method after the warehouse confirms the returned item.

cases.query: When should support open a carrier investigation for tracking that stopped moving?
cases.answer: If tracking has not updated for more than 72 hours, support should open a carrier investigation. A package is treated as lost when the carrier confirms loss or when there has been no tracking movement for 7 calendar days after the expected delivery date. Tracking becomes available when the carrier scans the parcel. Once an order is fulfilled, support must not promise an address change; the customer may contact the carrier if the carrier offers rerouting.

cases.query: Can I change my delivery address after fulfillment?
cases.answer: Customers may change the delivery address only before the order enters fulfillment. Standard domestic shipping usually arrives in 3 to 5 business days after fulfillment. Expedited shipping usually arrives in 1 to 2 business days after fulfillment. Orders may take up to 24 hours to enter fulfillment after payment is confirmed.

cases.query: Does cancelling Northstar Plus refund the current billing period?
cases.answer: Cancellation stops the next renewal but does not automatically refund the current billing period. Northstar Plus renews monthly on the customer's billing date. # Northstar Plus Subscription If a customer was charged after a cancellation request, support should verify the cancellation timestamp and billing timestamp.

cases.query: What secrets should support never ask a customer to share?
cases.answer: Support must never ask customers to share passwords, one-time passcodes, recovery codes, or full payment-card numbers. If a customer was charged after a cancellation request, support should verify the cancellation timestamp and billing timestamp. For suspected account takeover, support should first secure the account by invalidating active sessions and triggering the verified recovery flow. A customer can request deletion of their account from Settings > Privacy.

cases.query: When should a pending refund be escalated to Tier 2?
cases.answer: Escalate to Tier 2 when a customer reports three or more failed payment attempts with different valid payment methods, when a refund remains pending for more than 10 business days after provider submission, or when a carrier investigation is unresolved for more than 5 business days. Refund status can be checked after a return is received. For a suspected account takeover involving a changed payout destination, mark the case as high priority and route it to Trust & Safety immediately. If cancellation was completed before the billing event, the charge should be escalated for billing correction.
